name: Create History Note
description: Creates a new note adding it to a document.

configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: endpoint
configurable_props.label: Endpoint
configurable_props.description: The URL component, endpoint of the document type to add the history note. See [supported document types](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/history-and-notes#SupportedDocs)

configurable_props.name: guid
configurable_props.label: GUID
configurable_props.description: Xero identifier of the document to add a history note to.

configurable_props.name: details
configurable_props.label: Details
configurable_props.description: The note to be recorded against a single document. Max Length 250 characters.
